keywords.rule: Counts are papers whose title or abstract contains one of the keyword's phrases (porter-stemmed, as the theme trends); the baseline is the papers in scope first submitted in the 12 weeks before the issue, its own papers excluded. new: fewer than 5 baseline papers; rising: at least 10 papers and a rate at least 1.5 times the baseline rate; hot: at least 40 papers (and 1% of the issue) at a rate at least 0.67 times the baseline rate; steady: otherwise.
keywords.score: log2(1 + n) · log2(1 + (n + 3) / (E + 3)), E = issue papers × (baseline papers with the phrase + 0.5) / baseline papers

keywords.name: Coding Agents
keywords.about: Coding agents are benchmarked on context compaction, repository instruction files, and long-horizon software tasks.

keywords.name: Generative Recommendation
keywords.about: Recommenders generate semantic tokens and item codes, with distillation across spaces and recurrent depth scaling.

keywords.name: Multi-Agent Systems
keywords.about: LLM multi-agent workflows are mined, orchestrated, and stress-tested for trust and model heterogeneity.

keywords.name: Continual Learning
keywords.about: Continual learning spans sparsity-based pretraining, concept steering, and neuromorphic sub-network freezing under faults.

keywords.name: Humanoid Robots
keywords.about: Humanoids learn boxing, cooperative carrying, motion tracking, and recoverability monitoring, largely on Unitree hardware.

keywords.name: Supervised Fine-Tuning
keywords.about: SFT remains the base training stage for tool-use agents, orchestration models, and sovereign model recipes.

keywords.name: Robot Demonstrations
keywords.about: Demonstration data is selected, segmented with kinematic cues, and scaled with egocentric humanoid experience.

keywords.name: Spiking Neural Networks
keywords.about: Spiking and event-based networks get FPGA accelerators, robust firing scaffolds, and onboard satellite pose estimation.

keywords.name: Self-Distillation
keywords.about: Models distill their own outputs on-policy, with hindsight hints and monitorability constraints.

keywords.name: Vision-Language Models
keywords.about: Vision-language models are made cheaper through visual routing and used as judges, OCR systems, and action models.

themes.name: LLM evaluation, benchmarking, and rubric meta-science
themes.summary: These papers audit whether LLM evaluations, judges, rubrics, and benchmarks measure the intended constructs. They probe data leakage, judge version changes, and prompt artifacts, and propose expert-grounded and conformance-based evaluation protocols.
members: 2026-10-26: LLM evaluation, benchmarking, and rubric meta-science
2026-10-27: LLM benchmark validity and evaluation artifacts

themes.name: Robot learning, world models, and embodied navigation
themes.summary: These papers build vision-language-action policies, world-action models, and navigation systems for manipulation, locomotion, and embodied planning. They emphasize learning from egocentric video, sim-to-real transfer, spatial reasoning, and deployment on physical robots.
members: 2026-10-26: Embodied AI: robot learning and world models
2026-10-30: World Models, Planning, and Embodied Navigation

themes.name: Medical imaging and clinical foundation models
themes.summary: These papers develop segmentation, classification, multimodal, and foundation models for pathology, radiology, and clinical decision support. They emphasize annotation efficiency, robustness, interpretability, and deployment.
members: 2026-10-26: Medical imaging and clinical decision support
2026-10-27: Medical imaging foundation and multimodal models
2026-10-28: Medical imaging and clinical foundation models

themes.name: Generative modeling: diffusion, flow, 3D, and video
themes.summary: Papers develop diffusion and flow-based generative models and extend them to 3D reconstruction, Gaussian splatting, and video generation or editing. They address efficient sampling, geometric consistency, and compositional guidance for visual synthesis.
members: 2026-10-28: Diffusion and flow matching generative models

themes.name: LLM coding agents and software engineering
themes.summary: These papers benchmark and improve LLM agents for code generation, repository tasks, GUI grounding, and automated scientific discovery. They contribute agent harnesses, memory for repositories, verification and self-evaluation methods, and multi-agent orchestration.
members: 2026-10-26: LLM agents: tools, coding, memory, enterprise

themes.name: Efficient LLM inference and serving

news.title: Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences
news.summary: OpenAI said it will honor a common signal in robots.txt through which website operators can express one AI training preference to multiple participating providers, replacing the need to maintain per-provider crawler rules. OpenAI aims to implement it in the coming months, said the signal will not replace its existing robots.txt crawler controls, and tied the effort to the IETF AI Preferences working group.

news.title: Community safety report and new protections for teens
Fair use benefits everyone
An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI
news.summary: OpenAI updated its public Model Spec, reorganizing guidance around five values: faithfulness to human intent, harm minimization, honesty and transparency, human agency, and care. The revision adds guidance on context, oversight, and agency, adjusts some behavioral defaults, and retires much of the detailed style guidance.

news.title: Gemini 4 Carbon: Our next frontier model
news.summary: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Carbon, which ranks #1 on the v5.0 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at 59 and scores 88.2% on SEC-bench Pro, 54.8% on ExploitGym and 71.0% on CWE-bench, plus #4 at 1768 on WebDev Arena (+89 elo). It launched at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens with cached input at 95% off, initially available to a subset of cyber defenders and then trusted partners via the Fairwind Program, building on Gemini 4 Argon from two weeks earlier.

news.title: Genie 4: A new generation of world simulation
news.summary: Google DeepMind announced Genie 4, a natively multimodal world model that generates audio, ambient noise, and dialogue alongside interactive simulation, built on Gemini family models including Gemini Omni. It is rolling out as a research preview to trusted testers, starting with Google AI Ultra subscribers in Project Genie and early access partners of the Gemini API and Google AI Studio.

news.title: The sleep framework: A new way for LLMs to retain knowledge in continual learning
news.summary: Google Research introduced a "sleep" framework for continual learning in which LLMs alternate between an active wake phase and an offline sleep phase that consolidates short-term context into parameters via MoE expansion, knowledge seeding, and self-generated practice examples. The authors report the approach lets models acquire new facts, retain long-context knowledge up to 10M tokens, and improve reasoning while mitigating catastrophic forgetting.

news.title: Our newest AI Quest: Mapping the human brain
news.summary: Google Research and the Stanford Accelerator for Learning launched "Polar Peaks," the third quest in the AI Quests series, teaching students ages 11 to 14 to map neurons using AI via tasks including data cleaning and model testing, inspired by connectomics research including the mapping of the complete fruit fly brain. More than 400,000 quests have been completed to date, localized to 10 languages, and teacher training modules launch in the Google AI Educator Series with the module for Quest #3 following next month; the program won a 2026 Webby Award for AI Education, Learning & Training and a Best Global K-12 Learning Solution award at the ETIH Innovation Awards.

news.title: AI for Science expands to foundations and institutions
news.summary: Anthropic expanded its AI for Science program, started in May 2025, to 20 scientific foundations, institutions and research groups that will distribute free Claude credits to researchers. Partners named include the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation, Simons Foundation, Schmidt Sciences, Renaissance Philanthropy's Open Source for Science Fund, the $9 billion US National Science Foundation and CAS, alongside work with HHMI Janelia on the Model Hardware Standard (in research preview) and the Allen Institute.

news.title: Expanding our partnership with GSA to bring Claude to all levels of government
news.summary: Anthropic expanded its GSA partnership with a 40% discount on Claude Enterprise, Claude for Government and the Claude API that also covers state, local, tribal and territorial governments and is estimated to save the government $1 billion, with no minimum spend commitment. The post reports about 500 US federal, state and local organizations using Claude, weekly Claude for Government active users up about eightfold since February and federal civilian usage up about 20-fold in a year, and notes Claude for Government reached general availability on September 30 at FedRAMP High.

news.title: Anthropic files S-1 with the SEC for proposed initial public offering
news.summary: Anthropic, PBC filed a registration statement on Form S-1 with the SEC for a proposed IPO of Class A common stock, intending to list on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol "ANT". The number of shares to be offered and the price range have not yet been determined, and the registration statement has not yet become effective.

news.title: From synthetic enterprise data evaluations to real Microsoft Copilot AI confidence
news.summary: Microsoft Research described its Industry Evaluation Data Generation Platform, which builds full-scale synthetic enterprise "tenants" grounded in public sources such as O*NET occupational data, job postings and SEC filings to evaluate Microsoft Copilot without using customer data. The platform combines synthetic environments, automated query generation pipelines and structured quality frameworks, with content-safety checks, and is presented as establishing a first standardized evaluation baseline for Copilot.

news.title: Microsoft Research Focus – Edition #97
Things That Go Beep in the Night: Agentic AI Joins the Search for Extraterrestrial Signals
news.summary: NVIDIA reported that Breakthrough Listen and the SETI Institute are using agentic AI to steer the Allen Telescope Array, with the Holoscan-based DAQIRI library pulling terabits per second of sensor data directly into GPU memory, CyberEther signal processing on CUDA-X libraries, and the Nexus orchestrator handling 2.4 terabits per second on RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs with on-premises inference. The pipeline achieved the first real-time AI detection of a pulsar in the Crab Nebula, and the team is evaluating open models including NVIDIA Nemotron for offline observatory use.

news.title: Into the Omniverse: How Developers Turn Ideas Into Simulations With Frontier AI Agents
news.summary: NVIDIA described developer projects that combine frontier AI models such as GPT-6 Astra with Omniverse libraries for simulation building. Examples include a gas-turbine digital twin with six test procedures and a kitchen scene with 180 placements drawn from 63 unique assets plus 18 custom geometry pieces, using the SimReady Central Library announced at GTC Berlin with more than 2,000 USD assets.

news.title: Slice Into GFN Thursday: ‘Phantom Blade Zero’ Launches on GeForce NOW
news.summary: GeForce NOW added S-GAME’s Phantom Blade Zero, set for a Nov. 4 launch of World of Warcraft: Forever at 3 p.m. PST, nine games from the library, and mod support for Cyberpunk 2077 and The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered. Phantom Blade Zero is built on Unreal Engine 5 and features more than 30 primary weapons and over 20 Phantom Edges, with Ultimate members getting GeForce RTX 5080-class performance in the cloud.

news.title: Thin, Light and Built for Everything: NVIDIA RTX Spark Windows Laptops Gain New Models, Agent Tools and Games
news.summary: NVIDIA said RTX Spark laptops are now available from ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft and MSI, combining a Blackwell RTX GPU and Grace CPU with up to 128GB unified memory and up to 1 petaflop of FP4 AI performance. Updates include the open weight Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe speech model (40 languages including seven Indic, about 4.3 billion active parameters, 80% fewer than the No. 1 open weight model, No. 1 on Hugging Face Open ASR and No. 2 among open weight models on Artificial Analysis), LFM3 day-zero support, and NVIDIA App controls for splitting GPU resources between foreground apps and background agents.

news.title: Build a Validated Kubernetes Runtime for NVIDIA Dynamo
news.summary: NVIDIA described using its AI Cluster Runtime (AICR) to package Dynamo and its Kubernetes dependencies into validated recipes with pinned versions, covering driver stacks, Dynamic Resource Allocation, gang scheduling, node health and Prometheus metrics. Dynamo 1.4.2 uses TCP for the request plane and ZMQ for KV-cache events, supporting both the native Dynamo Frontend router and the Gateway API Inference Extension/Endpoint Picker path, deployed through a five-step flow ending in runtime validation before workloads are installed.

news.title: Run AI Models for Edge Application Development with Just a Few Commands
news.summary: NVIDIA outlined running Nemotron-3.5 Lightning on a DGX Spark 64GB with TensorRT Edge-LLM 0.11.1 and the trtedge CLI, which downloads the model (about 21GB) and builds TensorRT engines for deployment on Jetson Thor, DRIVE AGX Thor and IGX Thor. Enabling DSpark speculative decoding with three draft tokens raised mean generation speed from 73.4 to 126.9 tokens per second on HumanEval prompts with peak memory of 27.9GB.

news.title: Build Specialized Agents on a Stack You Control with NVIDIA NemoClaw
news.summary: NVIDIA introduced NemoClaw open blueprints that combine a tuned harness (OpenClaw, Nous Research's Hermes Agent or LangChain Deep Agents), Nemotron models, NeMo optimization tools and the OpenShell secure runtime for policy-governed agent access. LangChain tuned Deep Agents for Nemotron 3 Ultra to reach near-frontier performance at roughly 10x lower cost per run, and the blueprints run on cloud, data center, DGX Spark and RTX PCs.

news.title: How to Check and Configure NVIDIA GPUDirect Storage for Your Platform
news.summary: NVIDIA released gds-diag, an open-source command-line utility in the Magnum IO GitHub repository that checks GPUDirect Storage environments, reports findings with FAIL, WARN, INFO and PASS badges plus mitigation plans, and requires Python 3.8 or newer. An optional agent skill adds a natural-language interface that selects subcommands, orchestrates multi-step diagnostics and proposes remediation.

news.title: nemotron-halloween
news.summary: A Hugging Face post describes MonsterHouse, a Halloween interactive projection built on the NVIDIA Nemotron Voice Agent using Nemotron 3 ASR, Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB with a LoRA personality adapter, Magpie TTS Zeroshot and Audio2Face-3D in Unreal Engine 5, with Nemotron 3 Nano Omni, YOLO and ByteTrack for visitor perception. The system runs self-contained on one workstation with an RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q and an RTX PRO 4000 Blackwell.

news.title: Granite Switch 4.1.1 — Update models like you update software
news.summary: Hugging Face released Granite Switch 4.1.1, a backwards-compatible patch with an updated Granite Speech ASR model covering 10 languages with native punctuation and capitalization, plus an updated Decision adapter in granitelib-core. The base model is untouched, and the team says it is working on tutorials and an Adapter SDK for third-party adapters.

news.title: Announcing Project ProtoStar: Making Publicly Funded Science AI-Ready
news.summary: Project ProtoStar was announced to make publicly funded scientific datasets, models and code AI-ready and reusable, with founding partners Carnegie Mellon, Purdue, Georgia Tech, Arizona State and George Washington University via the Open Forum for AI, the Astera Institute, Hugging Face and ORCA; the first challenge, hosted by Carnegie Mellon, opens on November 2. The post cites roughly $190 billion in annual US federal R&D spending, more than 17,000 public science datasets on Hugging Face (approaching 29,000 including medicine and mathematics), and more than three times as many new science datasets shared in the first nine months of 2026 as in the same period of 2025.

news.title: Welcome Le Chonk: Mistral Large 4 on Hugging Face
news.summary: Mistral released Mistral Large 4 ("Le Chonk"), a multimodal, multilingual Mixture-of-Experts model with about 1T total and 49B active parameters and a 1M-token context window, in FP8 and NVFP4 variants plus GGUFs from Unsloth and the llama.cpp team under the Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License. It scores 82% on the Artificial Analysis Cyber Index, and its 72-layer text decoder with hidden dimension 6,144 and 64 attention heads combines Multi-head Latent Attention with a DeepSeek Sparse Attention indexer selecting up to 2,048 key positions per query.

news.title: GHARP: Real-Time Gaussian Head Animation from Large-Scale Reconstruction Prior
news.summary: Apple researchers presented GHARP, which animates 3D human heads in real time from a few input images and a driving expression signal by separating an offline identity stage from a lightweight runtime animation stage in a pretrained reconstruction model's latent space. A body alignment network addresses underspecified body pose and clothing, and the method achieves state-of-the-art quality on Ava-256 while running up to 13x faster on an A100 GPU with 8x fewer Gaussians.

news.title: Managing Amazon Bedrock costs end to end: A playbook for FinOps and platform teams
news.summary: AWS published a five-stage operating model for managing Amazon Bedrock spend — attribute, observe, enforce, optimize, operate — split between FinOps and platform engineering teams. Attribution relies on Bedrock's automatic per-request cost attribution to the calling IAM principal, recorded in the line_item_iam_principal column of the Cost and Usage Report 2.0 across IAM users, roles, federated identities and API keys.

news.title: Preview web apps live as your coding agent builds them with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime
news.summary: AWS described Session endpoints in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime that give each agent session an authenticated URL for opening a running app in a browser, forwarding HTTP method, path, query string, body and WebSocket traffic to ports configured via allowedPorts (1-5 entries in the 8000-12000 range, excluding reserved ports). Requests are SigV4-signed or bearer-token authenticated, require bedrock-agentcore:InvokeAgentRuntimeProxy, connect on port 443 with a host-name prefix selecting the target port, and the SDK client can proxy through http://localhost:8088.

news.title: How Worldwide Express automated freight exceptions with Amazon Bedrock
news.summary: AWS described how Worldwide Express (about $5 billion in systemwide revenue, over 75 LTL carriers and more than 130,000 customers) built a multi-agent Amazon Bedrock solution integrated with its SpeedShip TMS to resolve billing exceptions, with three specialized agents behind an orchestration layer on Amazon EC2. Six months after launch it reported a 75% reduction in active exceptions, a 4-week improvement in time-to-cash, $1M in annual savings and a one-time $10M free cash flow infusion, against $15 million in monthly cash flow previously tied up, and roughly 14% of invoices failing the three-way match.

news.title: Configure the ChatGPT desktop app with Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US)
news.summary: AWS published a walkthrough for configuring the ChatGPT desktop app and Codex on Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US), routing model requests through Amazon Bedrock Mantle in us-gov-west-1 under IAM and existing GovCloud network controls. The setup uses per-token pricing with no seat licenses or per-developer commitments, supports zero data retention, and keeps processing within the selected Bedrock Region.

en.editorial: This week's arXiv load fell to 2,180 papers from 3,870 last week, but agent-focused submissions drew the most votes. 'ChronoReplay' argues one answer interface is insufficient for streaming spatial intelligence, 'The Trinity:Capability-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Multimodal Agents' pushes recursive self-improvement, and 'Trajectory2Gym' synthesizes tool-use interactions. Reliability audits are timely: 'Trial by Trace' benchmarks harnesses for failure attribution, and 'Memory Tax' finds many memory systems underperform naive RAG. Embodied and world-model work continues with 'PDRVLA', 'DynaFlow', and 'Hy-Nomas'. Scientific ML was the only rising theme (change 1.74), while LLM evaluation meta-science remained steady (change 0.98). Industry releases also shifted the landscape: Google DeepMind shipped Gemini 4 Carbon and Genie 4, and Anthropic filed for an IPO.

news.title: Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences
news.summary: OpenAI 表示将遵守 robots.txt 中的一种通用信号，网站运营者可通过该信号向多个参与提供商表达一项 AI 训练偏好，从而无需维护针对每个提供商的爬虫规则。OpenAI 计划在未来几个月内实施该信号，并表示该信号不会取代其现有的 robots.txt 爬虫控制，同时将该工作与 IETF AI Preferences 工作组联系起来。

news.title: Community safety report and new protections for teens
Fair use benefits everyone
An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI
news.summary: OpenAI updated its public Model Spec, reorganizing guidance around five values: faithfulness to human intent, harm minimization, honesty and transparency, human agency, and care. The revision adds guidance on context, oversight, and agency, adjusts some behavioral defaults, and retires much of the detailed style guidance.

news.title: Gemini 4 Carbon: Our next frontier model
news.summary: Google DeepMind 发布了 Gemini 4 Carbon，该模型在 v5.0 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 上排名 #1，得分为 59，并在 SEC-bench Pro 上得分为 88.2%，在 ExploitGym 上得分为 54.8%，在 CWE-bench 上得分为 71.0%，在 WebDev Arena 上排名 #4，得分为 1768（+89 elo）。其发布价格为每百万输入 token $2，每百万输出 token $10，缓存输入价格低 95%，最初面向部分网络防御者，随后通过 Fairwind Program 面向可信合作伙伴，基于两周前发布的 Gemini 4 Argon 构建。

news.title: Genie 4: A new generation of world simulation
news.summary: Google DeepMind 发布了 Genie 4，这是一款原生多模态世界模型，除了交互式仿真外，还能生成音频、环境噪声和对话，基于 Gemini 系列模型（包括 Gemini Omni）构建。它正在以研究预览版形式向可信测试者推出，首先面向 Project Genie 中的 Google AI Ultra 订阅用户以及 Gemini API 和 Google AI Studio 的早期访问合作伙伴。

news.title: The sleep framework: A new way for LLMs to retain knowledge in continual learning
news.summary: Google Research 推出了一种用于持续学习的“睡眠”框架，在该框架中，LLM 在主动清醒阶段和离线睡眠阶段之间交替，后者通过 MoE 扩展、知识播种和自生成练习示例将短期上下文巩固到参数中。作者报告称，该方法使模型能够获取新事实，保留长达 10M token 的长上下文知识，并在减轻灾难性遗忘的同时提高推理能力。

news.title: Our newest AI Quest: Mapping the human brain
news.summary: Google Research 和斯坦福学习加速器推出了“Polar Peaks”，这是 AI Quests 系列中的第 3 个任务，教 11 至 14 岁的学生使用 AI 绘制神经元图谱，任务包括数据清洗和模型测试，灵感来自连接组学研究，包括完整果蝇大脑图谱。迄今为止已完成超过 400,000 个任务，本地化为 10 种语言，教师培训模块将在 Google AI Educator Series 中推出，Quest #3 的模块将于下个月发布；该项目获得了 2026 年 Webby Award 的 AI 教育、学习与培训奖项，以及 ETIH Innovation Awards 的最佳全球 K-12 学习解决方案奖。

news.title: AI for Science expands to foundations and institutions
news.summary: Anthropic expanded its AI for Science program, started in May 2025, to 20 scientific foundations, institutions and research groups that will distribute free Claude credits to researchers. Partners named include the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation, Simons Foundation, Schmidt Sciences, Renaissance Philanthropy's Open Source for Science Fund, the $9 billion US National Science Foundation and CAS, alongside work with HHMI Janelia on the Model Hardware Standard (in research preview) and the Allen Institute.

news.title: Expanding our partnership with GSA to bring Claude to all levels of government
news.summary: Anthropic expanded its GSA partnership with a 40% discount on Claude Enterprise, Claude for Government and the Claude API that also covers state, local, tribal and territorial governments and is estimated to save the government $1 billion, with no minimum spend commitment. The post reports about 500 US federal, state and local organizations using Claude, weekly Claude for Government active users up about eightfold since February and federal civilian usage up about 20-fold in a year, and notes Claude for Government reached general availability on September 30 at FedRAMP High.

news.title: Anthropic files S-1 with the SEC for proposed initial public offering
news.summary: Anthropic, PBC 已向 SEC 提交 S-1 表格注册声明，拟首次公开募股发行 A 类普通股，并计划在纳斯达克全球精选市场上市，股票代码为“ANT”。拟发行股份数量和价格区间尚未确定，且该注册声明尚未生效。

news.title: From synthetic enterprise data evaluations to real Microsoft Copilot AI confidence
news.summary: 微软研究院介绍了其行业评估数据生成平台，该平台基于 O*NET 职业数据、招聘信息和 SEC 备案等公开来源构建全面的合成企业“租户”，从而在不使用客户数据的情况下评估 Microsoft Copilot。该平台结合了合成环境、自动化查询生成流水线和结构化质量框架，并包含内容安全检查，被提出作为 Copilot 的首个标准化评估基线。

news.title: Microsoft Research Focus – Edition #97
Things That Go Beep in the Night: Agentic AI Joins the Search for Extraterrestrial Signals
news.summary: NVIDIA 报告称，Breakthrough Listen 和 SETI 研究所正在使用智能体 AI 来操控艾伦望远镜阵列，基于 Holoscan 的 DAQIRI 库将每秒数太比特的传感器数据直接拉入 GPU 内存，CyberEther 信号处理在 CUDA-X 库上运行，Nexus 编排器在 RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU 上以每秒 2.4 terabits 的速率处理数据并进行本地推理。该流水线实现了对蟹状星云脉冲星的首次实时 AI 探测，团队正在评估包括 NVIDIA Nemotron 在内的开放模型用于天文台离线使用。

news.title: Into the Omniverse: How Developers Turn Ideas Into Simulations With Frontier AI Agents
news.summary: NVIDIA 介绍了将 GPT-6 Astra 等前沿 AI 模型与 Omniverse 库相结合用于仿真构建的开发者项目。示例包括一个带有 6 个测试程序的燃气轮机数字孪生，以及一个包含 180 个摆放位置的厨房场景，这些摆放来自 63 个独特资产和 18 个自定义几何部件，使用了在 GTC Berlin 上宣布的 SimReady Central Library，该库包含超过 2,000 个 USD 资产。

news.title: Slice Into GFN Thursday: ‘Phantom Blade Zero’ Launches on GeForce NOW
news.summary: GeForce NOW added S-GAME’s Phantom Blade Zero, set for a Nov. 4 launch of World of Warcraft: Forever at 3 p.m. PST, nine games from the library, and mod support for Cyberpunk 2077 and The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered. Phantom Blade Zero is built on Unreal Engine 5 and features more than 30 primary weapons and over 20 Phantom Edges, with Ultimate members getting GeForce RTX 5080-class performance in the cloud.

news.title: Thin, Light and Built for Everything: NVIDIA RTX Spark Windows Laptops Gain New Models, Agent Tools and Games
news.summary: NVIDIA said RTX Spark laptops are now available from ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft and MSI, combining a Blackwell RTX GPU and Grace CPU with up to 128GB unified memory and up to 1 petaflop of FP4 AI performance. Updates include the open weight Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe speech model (40 languages including seven Indic, about 4.3 billion active parameters, 80% fewer than the No. 1 open weight model, No. 1 on Hugging Face Open ASR and No. 2 among open weight models on Artificial Analysis), LFM3 day-zero support, and NVIDIA App controls for splitting GPU resources between foreground apps and background agents.

news.title: Build a Validated Kubernetes Runtime for NVIDIA Dynamo
news.summary: NVIDIA described using its AI Cluster Runtime (AICR) to package Dynamo and its Kubernetes dependencies into validated recipes with pinned versions, covering driver stacks, Dynamic Resource Allocation, gang scheduling, node health and Prometheus metrics. Dynamo 1.4.2 uses TCP for the request plane and ZMQ for KV-cache events, supporting both the native Dynamo Frontend router and the Gateway API Inference Extension/Endpoint Picker path, deployed through a five-step flow ending in runtime validation before workloads are installed.

news.title: Run AI Models for Edge Application Development with Just a Few Commands
news.summary: NVIDIA outlined running Nemotron-3.5 Lightning on a DGX Spark 64GB with TensorRT Edge-LLM 0.11.1 and the trtedge CLI, which downloads the model (about 21GB) and builds TensorRT engines for deployment on Jetson Thor, DRIVE AGX Thor and IGX Thor. Enabling DSpark speculative decoding with three draft tokens raised mean generation speed from 73.4 to 126.9 tokens per second on HumanEval prompts with peak memory of 27.9GB.

news.title: Build Specialized Agents on a Stack You Control with NVIDIA NemoClaw
news.summary: NVIDIA 推出了 NemoClaw 开放蓝图，它将调优后的测试框架（OpenClaw、Nous Research 的 Hermes Agent 或 LangChain Deep Agents）、Nemotron 模型、NeMo 优化工具和 OpenShell 安全运行时相结合，用于策略管理的智能体访问。LangChain 为 Nemotron 3 Ultra 调优的 Deep Agents 实现了接近前沿水平的性能，每次运行成本约降低 10x，这些蓝图可在云、数据中心、DGX Spark 和 RTX PC 上运行。

news.title: How to Check and Configure NVIDIA GPUDirect Storage for Your Platform
news.summary: NVIDIA 发布了 gds-diag，这是 Magnum IO GitHub 仓库中的一个开源命令行工具，用于检查 GPUDirect Storage 环境，报告结果时使用 FAIL、WARN、INFO 和 PASS 徽章并提供缓解计划，要求 Python 3.8 或更高版本。一个可选的智能体技能增加了自然语言界面，可选择子命令、编排多步骤诊断并提出修复建议。

news.title: nemotron-halloween
news.summary: Hugging Face 的一篇文章介绍了 MonsterHouse，这是一个基于 NVIDIA Nemotron Voice Agent 构建的万圣节互动投影项目，使用 Nemotron 3 ASR、带有 LoRA 个性化适配器的 Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB、Magpie TTS Zeroshot 和 Unreal Engine 5 中的 Audio2Face-3D，并使用 Nemotron 3 Nano Omni、YOLO 和 ByteTrack 进行访客感知。该系统在一台配备 RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q 和 RTX PRO 4000 Blackwell 的工作站上独立运行。

news.title: Granite Switch 4.1.1 — Update models like you update software
news.summary: Hugging Face 发布了 Granite Switch 4.1.1，这是一个向后兼容的补丁，包含更新后的 Granite Speech ASR 模型，支持 10 种语言，具备原生标点和大小写功能，并在 granitelib-core 中更新了 Decision 适配器。基础模型保持不变，该团队表示正在开发教程和用于第三方适配器的 Adapter SDK。

news.title: Announcing Project ProtoStar: Making Publicly Funded Science AI-Ready
news.summary: Project ProtoStar was announced to make publicly funded scientific datasets, models and code AI-ready and reusable, with founding partners Carnegie Mellon, Purdue, Georgia Tech, Arizona State and George Washington University via the Open Forum for AI, the Astera Institute, Hugging Face and ORCA; the first challenge, hosted by Carnegie Mellon, opens on November 2. The post cites roughly $190 billion in annual US federal R&D spending, more than 17,000 public science datasets on Hugging Face (approaching 29,000 including medicine and mathematics), and more than three times as many new science datasets shared in the first nine months of 2026 as in the same period of 2025.

news.title: Welcome Le Chonk: Mistral Large 4 on Hugging Face
news.summary: Mistral 发布了 Mistral Large 4（“Le Chonk”），这是一款多模态、多语言的专家混合模型，总参数约 1T，活跃参数 49B，上下文窗口为 1M token，提供 FP8 和 NVFP4 变体，以及来自 Unsloth 和 llama.cpp 团队的 GGUFs，采用 Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License。它在 Artificial Analysis Cyber Index 上得分为 82%，其 72 层文本解码器隐藏维度为 6,144，有 64 个注意力头，将 Multi-head Latent Attention 与 DeepSeek Sparse Attention 索引器相结合，每个查询最多选择 2,048 个关键位置。

news.title: GHARP: Real-Time Gaussian Head Animation from Large-Scale Reconstruction Prior
news.summary: 苹果研究人员提出了 GHARP，它通过将离线身份阶段与轻量级运行时动画阶段在预训练重建模型的潜在空间中分离，从少量输入图像和驱动表情信号实时生成 3D 人头动画。一个身体对齐网络处理未充分指定的身体姿态和服装，该方法在 Ava-256 上达到了最先进的质量，同时在 A100 GPU 上运行速度最高快 13x，高斯数量少 8x。

news.title: Managing Amazon Bedrock costs end to end: A playbook for FinOps and platform teams
news.summary: AWS published a five-stage operating model for managing Amazon Bedrock spend — attribute, observe, enforce, optimize, operate — split between FinOps and platform engineering teams. Attribution relies on Bedrock's automatic per-request cost attribution to the calling IAM principal, recorded in the line_item_iam_principal column of the Cost and Usage Report 2.0 across IAM users, roles, federated identities and API keys.

news.title: Preview web apps live as your coding agent builds them with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime
news.summary: AWS 介绍了 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime 中的 Session 端点，它为每个智能体会话提供一个经过身份验证的 URL，用于在浏览器中打开正在运行的应用程序，并将 HTTP 方法、路径、查询字符串、正文和 WebSocket 流量转发到通过 allowedPorts 配置的端口（1-5 个条目，范围为 8000-12000，排除保留端口）。请求使用 SigV4 签名或 bearer token 身份验证，需要 bedrock-agentcore:InvokeAgentRuntimeProxy 权限，通过端口 443 连接，并使用主机名前缀选择目标端口，SDK 客户端可通过 http://localhost:8088 进行代理。

news.title: How Worldwide Express automated freight exceptions with Amazon Bedrock
news.summary: AWS described how Worldwide Express (about $5 billion in systemwide revenue, over 75 LTL carriers and more than 130,000 customers) built a multi-agent Amazon Bedrock solution integrated with its SpeedShip TMS to resolve billing exceptions, with three specialized agents behind an orchestration layer on Amazon EC2. Six months after launch it reported a 75% reduction in active exceptions, a 4-week improvement in time-to-cash, $1M in annual savings and a one-time $10M free cash flow infusion, against $15 million in monthly cash flow previously tied up, and roughly 14% of invoices failing the three-way match.

news.title: Configure the ChatGPT desktop app with Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US)
news.summary: AWS 发布了一份指南，介绍如何在 AWS GovCloud (US) 中配置 ChatGPT 桌面应用和 Codex 与 Amazon Bedrock 的集成，通过 us-gov-west-1 中的 Amazon Bedrock Mantle 路由模型请求，并遵守 IAM 和现有 GovCloud 网络控制。该设置采用按 token 定价，无需席位许可证或按开发者承诺，支持零数据保留，并将处理限制在所选的 Bedrock 区域内。
